english.title: Repair, reconstruct or alter the course of a drain without giving 24 hours notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), other than in the case of an emergency,

(A)_[repaired]_
(B)_[reconstructed]_
(C)_[altered the course of]_

an underground drain that communicated with a sewer, cesspool or other receptacle for drainage without giving to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) at least 24 hours' notice of your intention to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 61(1)(a) and (3) of the Building Act 1984.
